Lina Park: Starting a quick thread — I'm updating the Quickstart to include: Go hello-world, Ruby server example, service-token auth, and first deploy via `redwood deploy` CLI. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901

DocsBot: PR created by Lina Park — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901 · Status: draft

Diego Morales: Love the addition of Go. Quick question: in the Go example are we showing SDK v1 or v2? The public repo still has v1 in some snippets.

Lina Park: Using v2. Will use `client.ChatCompletions.Stream` (Go SDK naming). I'll paste the snippet below — feedback welcome.

Lina Park: ```go
package main

import (
  "os"
  "fmt"
  redwood "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
)

func main() {
  client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN"))
  stream, _ := client.ChatCompletions.Stream(redwood.ChatRequest{Model: "gpt-small", Messages: []redwood.Message{{Role: "user", Content: "Hello world from Go"}}})
  for chunk := range stream {
    fmt.Print(chunk.Text)
  }
}
```

Eli Turner: Snippet looks fine but please don't call the env var REDWOOD_API_KEY in docs when we recommend service tokens — use REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN or at least annotate.

Priya Shah: Also add a tiny note on rotating tokens and link to the security page. The private deploy link at /docs/enterprise/private-deploy has moved — should be /docs/private-deploy/vpc (caught this in an earlier audit).

Lina Park: Good catch on the variable. I'll change to REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN and add the CLI token example: `redwood tokens create quickstart --scopes=generate` and show the web console flow beneath it.

Diego Morales: For the Ruby snippet, can we use the sync example rather than stream? For onboarding folks a simple `client.chat.completions.create` is easier to follow.

Lina Park: Sure. Proposed Ruby snippet:

```rb
require "redwood"
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV["REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN"])
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model: "gpt-small", messages: [{role: "user", content: "Hello from Ruby"}])
puts resp.choices.first.text
```

Eli Turner: Also suggest adding a short migration callout: "If you used SDK v1, replace `streamResponses` with `ChatCompletions.Stream` and update env var names." Small code diff example would help.

Priya Shah: On CI — happy to add a GH Action that runs the snippets against a sandbox token. We'll need to redact tokens and make the action opt-in. I recommend `.github/workflows/snippets-smoke.yml` triggered for PRs labeled `run-snippets`.

Lina Park: Please add it as a follow-up commit on the PR. Also, Jamie asked in another thread about a credential recommendation table — I think we should include it in the Quickstart: Use-case -> Credential (Quick dev: Service token; Local dev with user login: User API Key; Production: KMS-backed rotation).

DocsBot: Checklist for PR reviewers:
- [ ] Change env var to REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN (Lina)
- [ ] Add CLI token example + web console (Lina)
- [ ] Update private deploy link to /docs/private-deploy/vpc (Priya)
- [ ] Add migration note for v1 -> v2 SDK naming (Eli)
- [ ] Add snippets smoke GH Action as opt-in (Priya)
- [ ] Add credential recommendation table (Lina/Diego)

Diego Morales: I can do a quick link sweep for other docs pages if someone assigns the task. Found a couple of other dead links in tutorials.

Lina Park: Assign to Diego — thanks. I'll push edits tonight and mark the PR ready for review when the CI action is attached.

DocsBot: PR status: draft updated · checks: none

Lina Park: Thanks team :pray:
